arms.Araw: phrase_proposal_s1.discover_source Araw, unchanged frozen S1 baseline
arms.R1_lag: contiguous lag-matrix recurrence on S1 log-band powers

dev_calibration.rule: maximize dev TP@IoU0.5 minus dev negative false candidates; ties -> larger theta

r1_settings.features: phrase_proposal_s1.extract log-band powers, bands <= 1800 Hz, per-band z-score over clip, frame cosine
r1_settings.maximal_extension: per (t, lag): largest window length with mean diagonal similarity >= theta
r1_settings.ranking: excess = sum over window of (similarity - theta) descending; ties: longer, earlier t, shorter lag

scoring.aggregation: sums, never averages of rates; abstentions stay in denominators
scoring.common_reference_mae: references matched by all three arms at IoU 0.5; denominator 4 x common; null with reason if empty
scoring.matched_endpoint_mae: all four endpoints of matched pairs; denominator 4 x matched pairs; null if none
scoring.matching: phrase_proposal_s1.score_rows: maximum cardinality then maximum mean two-span IoU
scoring.negative_false_candidates: candidate count per negative cohort over 2 cases

silence_cue_rule.rule: longest sub-threshold run within +-0.25 s of every truth endpoint <= longest run inside motif interiors
